newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: IBRD won bonds launched, signing due Monday-Daewoo.
newsitem.headline: IBRD won bonds launched, signing due Monday-Daewoo.

text.p: The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development's (IBRD) won-denominated bonds have been launched for domestic and overseas markets, an official at lead manager Daewoo Securities said on Friday.
Signing for the 95 billion won issue -- 71.5 billion worth for domestic and 23.5 billion for overseas markets -- is set for Monday, April 14, in Seoul, with payment due by April 23, he said.
It will be the first won-denominated bond issue by an international organisation on overseas markets.
The finance ministry said identical bond issues by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) would be signed on April 21.
The World Bank and the European Bank applied to the South Korean government for the bond issues in 1996.
